command:
set -euo pipefail
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega777-audio-gate.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$TMP/repo"
cd "$TMP/repo"
git fetch -q --depth 1 origin 58470f39ca4efdb26da1dc93bd7b10072fafb7d5
git checkout -q --detach 58470f39ca4efdb26da1dc93bd7b10072fafb7d5
echo OMEGA_AUDIO_GATE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
export PULSE_SOURCE=frank_out_ec.monitor
export PULSE_SINK=frank_out_ec
python3 scripts/voice777_cancel_loopback_probe.py --capture-device pulse --output-device pulse --sample-rate 48000 --tone-hz 880 --tone-amplitude 0.12 --frame-ms 20 --capture-window-ms 10 --pre-cancel-ms 300 --post-cancel-ms 450 --max-tail-ms 120
